title: Alphawaves dataset
description: The Alphawaves dataset comprises resting-state EEG recordings from 19 healthy participants acquired using a 16-channel g.tec g.USBamp system at 512 Hz sampling rate. Participants alternated between eyes-closed and eyes-open conditions in 10-second trials, with data annotated using HED 8.4.0 schema. This dataset is designed for benchmarking brain-computer interface algorithms and studying alpha oscillatory activity during different resting states.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded from 19 healthy subjects (mean age 25.8 years) using 16 wet electrodes in a standard 10-10 montage with reference at the right earlobe. Acquisition was performed with a g.tec g.USBamp amplifier at 512 Hz sampling rate using OpenViBE software. Subjects performed alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open resting-state conditions, each lasting 10 seconds, with 10 trials per session.
